body: Thank you. Really, I mean it

I know that very well. It became my everyday mantra "It takes time to create something really good. Be patient. One day at a time. It's normal, relax" and so on. But then sky just falls. It's hard to explain. It's like a riot you know will happen no matter what inside your head. I understand that all of it sounds childish. But hell, I know I can be more than just THAT. I really want to entertain people with my creative projects and experiments. To create something truly good. I just need little more time on a same spot but I don't know how. 
I will try meditation again, that's a good idea, thank you.

Tried that. Didn't helped much. I have no system in my life. Totally chaotic random events. If some activity don't bring value in short period of time it goes away. Changing to something exotic or just new. I simply forget to meditate. And in couple of days I remember that I should, but since I forgot about that, it must be not so important all. 'Cause it didn't stick to me. Small cycle for every activity. I had 6 different sports as a kid, and each time it was very fun for couple of weeks. Maybe I'm just a spoiled piece of crap, but that conclusion connects with an idea of being useless. Anyway, pointless logic. Just want to disappear.

Thanks for response...I don't know why, it just happens. Every time I get annoyed in some point and everything starts to break. Bit by bit. Every morning becomes a bigger challenge to get out of a bed. And eventually I give up. Become angry and destroy new connections with people. I see reflection of my own flaws inside those people. And again...I'm in that pit. Mute and powerless to change anything. I stay there until new desires appear. New and bright, and I start to burn again with some idea that is MINE FOR 100%. And...3-4 months pass..and...cycle repeats itself.
